input.body: Greedy best-first search chooses the frontier node with the lowest heuristic estimate, and it can ignore path cost and therefore does not guarantee an optimal solution. In contrast, uniform-cost search orders the frontier by accumulated path cost, and with nonnegative edge costs and suitable duplicate handling, it finds an optimal solution.
